changes.comment: Keep every entry and every singleton in its own folder with `index.json`; a singleton is `content/<name>/index.json`. `media` is a reserved name for a collection or a singleton, because the shared media folder sits beside their folders. The manifest records no layout. `entryFolder` and `entryDataPath` are new. Removed: `collectionEntryPath`, `singletonPath`, `entryLayout`, `deriveLayout`, `recordLayout`, `misplacedFiles`, `LayoutError`, `RowNumberError`, `keyRepeaterRows`, `numberedDocuments`, `EntryLayout` and `ManifestLayout`. Changed: `entryFiles(folder, serialized)` and `collectionSlugs(source, name)`.
